name: Rhubarb

schedule.notes: Plant divided crowns 1 in below soil in early spring. Pick a permanent spot — lives 10 to 15+ years.
Heavy feeder. Compost top-dress every spring.
NO harvest year 1. Light harvest year 2. Full harvest year 3+ (8 to 10 weeks until early July).

harvest.cues: Stalks 12 to 18 in long, finger-thick, firm. Pull (don't cut) with a twist. Leaves are TOXIC — compost them.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in plastic 1 to 2 weeks. Chop and freeze raw for winter pies.

varieties.name: Victoria
varieties.notes: Tangy classic. Stalks have green-red blush, not full red.

varieties.name: Canada Red
varieties.notes: Deep red stalks, sweeter than Victoria. Slightly less productive.

notes: Stop harvesting in midsummer to let the plant rebuild. Divide every 5 to 8 years. Cut flower stalks immediately — they sap the crown. Needs cold dormancy; struggles south of zone 8.
